audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 contradict the packet chart, the mirror and our own whys[]. Rows 0 and 1 read Skill/Yorick while whys[0] and whys[1] say Warwick's Q healing wins them; row 2 reads Yorick while whys[2] calls it even; row 4 reads Skill while whys[4] gives Level 6 to Yorick.
audit.why: The mirror already set these four rows; a page that shows Yorick winning Level 2 above a sentence saying Warwick's healing keeps him ahead is worse than either answer alone.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 -> Warwick (3/10), row 2 -> Skill, row 4 -> Yorick (7/10), as matched full/content pairs in one chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row was rated as a coin-flip when it is the flip point of the lane, and the spike text never gave the numbers behind it.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a 1.5s suppress on 110/90/70s; once it is down and Maiden is up, ghoul DPS beats his single-target sustain. That cooldown is what makes the window real.
audit.corrected: Row 4 handed to Yorick at 7/10 and dontsFull[1].d now carries the 1.5s suppress and 110/90/70s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blood Hunt is called 'the passive' in spikes[0].text, content.early and wants.foe[1] — it is his W, and Eternal Hunger is the passive. Separately, the page never says Jaws of the Beast is max-health damage, so it still implies armour answers him.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Blood Hunt (W), 4000 range, 80/70/60/50/40s, triggers on targets below 50% health. Eternal Hunger (P) heals him on autos below 50% and triples below 25%. Jaws of the Beast (Q) deals damage based on maximum health and heals for it.
audit.corrected: Blood Hunt attributed to W in all three fields; dosFull[1].d now states the passive's 50%/25% healing and the anti-heal timing; dontsFull[0].d states Q's max-health damage so nobody buys armour and calls it solved.

edits.before: Warwick's early sustain is the problem: Jaws of the Beast (Q) heals him hard and Blood Hunt (passive) speeds him toward you when you're low, and Primal Howl (E) blocks a chunk of your burst. Trade in short bursts, don't let him ramp Q healing, and use Mourning Mist (E) to slow his Blood Hunt chase.
edits.after: Warwick's early sustain is the problem: Jaws of the Beast (Q) heals him for the damage it deals, Blood Hunt (W) speeds him at you the moment you drop under 50%, and Primal Howl (E) cuts your burst for 2.5s. Trade in short bursts and use Mourning Mist (E) to slow the Blood Hunt chase.

edits.before: Warwick wins levels 1-2: his Jaws of the Beast (Q) heals him through your trades, his Blood Hunt passive speeds him at you when you drop low, and his sustain simply out-lasts your early Q Last Rites pokes. Farm patiently, soak damage on ghouls from Shepherd of Souls, and don't dip low enough to trigger his Blood Hunt chase.
edits.after: Warwick wins levels 1-2: his Jaws of the Beast (Q) heals him through your trades, Blood Hunt (W) speeds him at you the moment you fall under 50% health, and his sustain out-lasts your early Q Last Rites pokes. Farm patiently, soak damage on ghouls from Shepherd of Souls, and don't dip under that 50% line while he holds W.

edits.before: Blood Hunt passive speed to chase you down when low
edits.after: Blood Hunt (W) speed to chase you under 50% HP

edits.before: His all-in lock. Cage it with your W. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dark Procession is destructible terrain on 20s — it walls his R leap.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Warwick so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Eternal Hunger heals him on every auto below 50% and triples under 25% — Executioner's Calling by your first back or he wins every long trade.

edits.before: Warwick wastes Infinite Duress — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mourning Mist marks him on a 12s cooldown — your ghouls sprint at the mark.

edits.before: That is Warwick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast is max-health damage that heals him — armour alone will not fix it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s on 110/90/70s — wall the leap.

notes: The kit file flags Infinite Duress as a 'channel — interruptible', but Riot's own description says only that he leaps and suppresses. I did not write any CC-cancels-his-R advice; that belongs in unverified until someone confirms it.
